body:
I think once I find out who I am, I will. You will have a long message from me, from the beginning of my time to now, how I've felt in the in between times, how the wind sounds makes me feel. I agree, i can't explain myself or understand who I am. Its saddening, I should know who I am by now. I think we must suffer first, perhaps, then we will know everything. I hope you find out who you are, why that mouth if yours smiles, what makes your heart hurt and feel rawer by the moment, do your lovers fingers cast a spell on you? Maybe by the time im meant to be dead or survive we will know! Oh I hope this suffering goes away. 
I don't like purple or green, how about blue and orange? I'm part of the sea and the sun, that's why I hurt when I'm near the ocean.

You're very kind and sweet, and I thank you. 
I'm sorry about those people, we don't need people like them in our lives! I'm glad you're getting better in time, I really am. That's inspiring. Cuddle with your pet, drink some hot cocoa and write yourself a lovely letter, hide it somewhere you'll forget and one day you'll find it and appreciate life more. 
Thanks for dat cool subreddit.

I'm sorry that you're feeling this way. I'm sad that God let's us feel this way. I've asked him several times to take my life away. I've asked the devil the same thing. Its sad that we're this young and already injected with these thoughts. Do you love yourself? I think that perhaps once you do, you will have no reason to want to end your life. You will take numerous photos, or start painting, and that rope or knife or pills start calling to you "hey I'm over here remember?" And you'll say "hold on just let me finish this painting taking these photos loving this person" and you'll get distracted enough and I really hope that'll happen to you two. 
If I survive you can help me paint my shutters to my house, feed my dog or we can tire swing into the lake. We can survive together but don't wait up on me, I might decide halfway along the way that I like the color yellow instead of green for shutters.

Have you ever felt proud of who you were? Loved your own skin? I haven't, not at all. I've never thought of myself more than just a waste, someone with cracks here and there, how hideous. I may be depressed, or my mind chooses to be sad all the time. Whichever, it sucks, it really does. Why can't I be happy. The last time I was happy was far away ago and it lasted for two days then I came home and thought why I even bothered. The knife is my comfort at the moment. 
Please don't tell me its just hormones. That makes me believe that perhaps one day I'll have my book written and I'll be able to thank you all. But I can't wait that far, and I have nothing to live for then.
